exposure: electroacupuncture (EA) stimulation at specific points SP6 and LI4 using frequencies of 30, 50, and 100 Hz
outcome: levels of the hormone b-endorphin (analyzed through blood samples using ELISA method)
cohort: The study included 144 postpartum cesarean section participants meeting specific inclusion criteria, divided into 8 intervention and control groups.
finding: Electroacupuncture at specific points LI4 and SP6 was effective in reducing pain by increasing levels of the hormone b-endorphin, compared to the control group.
